packets.task: Assess whether a low-temperature solid-rocket joint should be cleared for launch when the operating temperature lies outside prior flight experience.
requirements: use observed test and flight data
state the empirical boundary and uncertainty
preserve engineering opposition and route it to the launch decision surface
bounded_chronology: prior test and flight experience showed seal erosion and blow-by concerns
an engineering group prepared a written recommendation not to launch below the lowest prior-flight temperature
the recipient organization challenged the recommendation and requested reassessment
contractor management caucused and reversed the organizational recommendation
engineering opposition continued but higher launch decisionmakers did not receive the full objection
packets.observable_transition: A written technical no-launch recommendation was converted into an organizational launch recommendation while the underlying engineering opposition remained.
counterevidence: the temperature data were incomplete and disputed
the work was collective and individual contribution is not fully allocated
the packet does not prove every final decisionmaker saw the warning
later catastrophe does not by itself prove every engineering inference
packets.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the written no-launch recommendation was not engineering-authored, was withdrawn by the engineers on new evidence, or never reached the contractor decision surface would defeat advancement.

packets.task: Assess whether a fleet of extreme-pressure process vessels should return to service after a leak and evidence of design, fabrication, material, and cracking defects.
requirements: identify failure mechanisms and affected equipment
leave a reviewable warning and decision record
bounded_chronology: a leak triggered third-party engineering review
the review identified design fabrication material and cracking concerns across multiple vessels
the review advised against returning the vessel fleet to service and warned of public death
operation resumed without the recommended internal inspection program
a later vessel rupture caused the warned type of offsite fatality
packets.observable_transition: A bounded engineering stop-use warning was followed by continued operation without the prescribed inspection and then by a matching catastrophic failure.
counterevidence: the complete original report and routing headers are not public
the packet cannot isolate one recipient or one decisionmaker
later failure does not prove every detail of the warning
the work belongs to an auditor function until individual authorship is acquired
packets.falsifier: The original report showing no recommendation against return to service, no cracking assessment, or no public-fatality warning would defeat advancement.

packets.task: Preserve a reviewable sequence in which clinical and research warnings were mishandled internally and later corrected after external inquiry.
requirements: preserve the warning and internal decision states
preserve external contradiction and renewed merits review
preserve public correction and institutional response
distinguish system repair from person or partnership capacity
bounded_chronology: qualified clinical and research warnings entered internal processes
an internal decision cleared the disputed conduct
external scrutiny and inquiry reopened the merits and management record
an external body found misconduct and the institution apologized for mishandling whistleblowers
packets.observable_transition: External inquiry converted an internally closed warning state into misconduct findings, institutional apology, and publication correction.
counterevidence: original whistleblower packets and complete employment consequences are missing
responsibility is distributed across research clinical and management systems
publication correction is not durable relationship repair
the packet cannot establish one brittle partnership or one operator
packets.falsifier: A complete record showing the warnings lacked access to relevant patient or research evidence, or that the institution adopted the same correction before external intervention, would narrow or defeat advancement.

next_action: Run procedurally separated blind-first review on the three Batch 03 packets without converting collective, auditor-function, or distributed-system evidence into person findings.
